commands: Read research checkpoint wrapper, maintained player/decoder ABI, preview evidence, and virtual-Cues generator/proxy; no builds or media execution.
analysis: R123 and R274 retain their original component-scoped pursue decisions and scientific stage evidence. New read-only audits identify concrete missing whole-player integration prerequisites; no performance failure or whole-player pass is asserted.

decisions.reason: Prior component-scoped pursue remains unchanged. Whole-player readiness: Not a JS policy or existing player ABI toggle. Faithful integration needs decoder-internal safe-boundary state plus demux position, mpv decode/filter/output queues, A/V clocks, cancellation and retained checkpoint lifetime. Existing research wrapper only owns a standalone single-thread AVC decoder. Narrow optional preview caching or already-pending batching has less decoder-internal integration burden when those requested workloads exist.
decisions.next_action: A measured user workload repeatedly seeks inside the same eligible software-decoded GOP, ordinary preview reuse/batching does not meet that request, and profiling shows decoder replay dominates enough to repay internal integration and retained-state cost.

decisions.reason: Prior component-scoped pursue remains unchanged. Whole-player readiness: Existing generator extracts Cues from an already indexed source and blanks those bytes; it does not construct Cues from an unindexed source. Existing proxy restores those574bytes in a3,652,612-byte file after fullsource/index hash validation and materializes the entire source. A Player wrapper alone cannot qualify a cold complete job including actual index construction.
decisions.next_action: A real authenticated prebuilt-index source is selected, or the actual scanner/author is implemented and construction costs included without replacing the requested mechanism with an already indexed proxy.
